[[File:CR90_corvette_Ralltiir.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The corvette.]]
A '''CR90 corvette''' was involved in the [[Defense of Ralltiir]]. It was helmed by [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]], who at the time held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]].

It was dispatched to the planet of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] to aid in the extraction of Ralltiir [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who wished to defect to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], based on information supplied by Imperial TIE pilot-turned-Rebel [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] when the latter [[Mission to Dantooine|defected]] to the Alliance. Late into the battle, however, it was infiltrated by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], thus resulting in a huge firefight between the Rebels and the Imperials before being cleared for takeoff.
